items.title: D'Imperio interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2014
items.q: And Billie Holiday was with that band too

ctx.x: It’s ironic because they told Benny Goodman the same thing — you’re going to lose 40 percent of your work if you hire Lionel Hampton or whatever.

Artie Shaw had that whole scene when he had Hot Lips Page and he couldn’t even do a southern tour unless Hot Lips was at least like ten feet away from the rest of the band. He turned down a whole southern tour. And Billie Holiday was with that band too and there © Fillius Jazz Archive -31-
were some problems along those lines too. But I mean other than that I can’t say there’s been an awful lot as far as I’m concerned with the black and white thing.
